jobs.title: Account Executive - FR & SE
jobs.ai_disclaimer:
As part of our recruitment process, Emplifi uses artificial intelligence ("AI") tools within our Applicant Tracking System to support our Talent Acquisition team in reviewing applications and identifying candidates whose skills and experience may align with the requirements of a role.


AI is used solely to assist our recruiters and hiring teams. It does not make hiring decisions, automatically reject candidates, or determine outcomes. All decisions regarding candidate progression and hiring are made by appropriately trained Emplifi employees following meaningful human review.


Candidate information, including resumes/CVs and application responses, may be processed by these AI-assisted tools. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please refer to our Recruitment Privacy Statement. To request a manual review of your application, contact hrdataprivacy@emplifi.io.
